identity.title: [v0.91.7][review-fix][runtime-v3] Resolve #5227 selector, guardian, and pressure-stop findings

values.summary: Clarify selector claims, harden the guardian process boundary, connect weather pressure to signed continuity and graceful shutdown, classify release evidence, then run exact focused and full Runtime v3 proof.

steps.action: Normalize selector and release-proof semantics around reporting and evidence classes
Harden guardian process-tree and bounded capture behavior with descendant tests
Integrate periodic pressure sampling with signed checkpoint and graceful kernel stop
Run focused, full, lint, inventory, and independent review proof

invariants: Runtime v3 remains independent of Runtime v2
Continuity is committed before a pressure stop is called clean
Descendants do not outlive guardian containment
Non-executed evidence never becomes live completion truth
risks: Shutdown races between weather, continuity, and control API
Release records overstating ignored or contract-only proof
Code growth above the Runtime v3 budget
stop_conditions: Any required change enters Runtime v2
Signed continuity cannot complete before shutdown
Focused process or pressure tests remain nondeterministic
